_comment: The game's material textures: the mix chosen after the look tests (docs/MODELS.md). blender: generated by tools/blender/make_textures.py (original). cc0: Poly Haven scans (CC0 1.0), fetched and made tintable by tools/textures/fetch_polyhaven.py.

paving.note: Albedo calmed by tools/textures/game_paving.py from the generated one (lab/blender): contrast at the power 0.55, neutral grey around 82% like the other game textures, so the layout's stone colour tints it. At full contrast the grout went black and the stones patchy on the game's pale squares and floors.

plaster.note: Colour variation at 0.32 of the generated texture's, around 82% grey: the full contrast read as dirt on the game's smaller, paler houses.
